text:
incident-bot: SYNTHETIC ALERT: canary-probe 'user-flow-1' failing 5x in a row in us-west-2. Severity: P2. Paging on-call. Link: https://console.redwood/in/alerts/1752301234 :rotating_light:

pagerduty: PagerDuty — page fired to on-call (hana). Incident: https://pd.redwood/INC1752301234

hana: Ack — looking now.

hana: Pulling canary dashboard and logs. @samir can you check the LB health & target groups while I tail the runner?

samir: On it. Tailing canary-runner logs now — seeing repeated gRPC timeouts to model-gateway: 
```
2026-03-12T17:00:10Z canary-runner[1]: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
2026-03-12T17:00:11Z canary-runner[1]: probe failed: latency 1200ms
```

hana: Prometheus check: `sum(rate(canary_probe_failures_total{env="prod",region="us-west-2"}[5m]))` shows a spike at 17:00 UTC.

opsbot: Runbook match: "canary-failure transient" — recommended actions: 1) restart canary-runner deployment 2) verify probe target health 3) escalate if failures persist >10m. Command: 
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/canary-runner-usw2
```

hana: Rolling restart now. :white_check_mark:

julia: I also see a 99th percentile latency bump on model-serving-gateway in us-west-2 around the same time — could be backend warmup or transient routing change.

kevin: Scaling nodepool-usw2 +1 to add headroom, triggered autoscaler manually (ETA ~90s).

samir: After restart logs look clean, probes succeeding: 
```
2026-03-12T17:02:05Z canary-runner[1]: probe ok status=200 latency=145ms
2026-03-12T17:02:06Z canary-runner[1]: probe ok status=200 latency=128ms
```

hana: Running a manual curl to the canary endpoint to validate end-to-end: 
```
curl -sS -D - https://canary.us-west-2.redwood/api/health -o /dev/null
HTTP/2 200
content-type: application/json
```

hana: Console shows no customer-facing errors in the last 10m; traffic normal. Impact: canary-only, no customers affected. Leaving monitoring window open for 15m.

pagerduty: PagerDuty — Incident acknowledged by hana (on-call).

hana: Handing off watch to julia for the next 4h. I have a meeting. Please reopen page if it recurs. :wave:

julia: Taking watch. I'll monitor dashboards and alert if it flaps.

incident-bot: Note: created follow-up ticket INC-FU-1752301234 in backlog for root-cause investigation.

samir: Quick follow-up: logs show short-lived upstream connection resets from model-gateway, likely routing churn during a config push at 16:59. Will add retries and bump probe timeouts as mitigation.

hana: Good catch. Action items: (1) samir create RFC with mitigation (retries + probe-tuning) (2) ops verify deployment gating to avoid config race on canary targets (3) julia monitor for 1h then close.

julia: Will do. Closing this page for now. Reopen if we see >3 failures in 10m.

samir: Adding runbook note about increasing probe max tries from 3->5 and adding backoff.

hana: Thanks team. Marking incident as resolved for paging — will follow up in postmortem if RCA confirms config push caused flapping. :tada:
